en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hussain from Ismail b. al-Zubayr from ’Amru b. Thabit from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said: “
Whoever recites this Surah would be kept safe by Allah from acting upon the mischief of Dajjal and he would remain safe from the chastisement of Hell.”
